docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Ramchandra Shukla's history of Hindi literature (1929), which gave the periods of Ādikāl, Bhaktikāl, Rītikāl and Ādhunik kāl their names and judged the poets of each.

From Wikisource · Public domain

Ramchandra Shukla (1884–1941), Hindī Sāhitya kā Itihās (Nagari Pracharini Sabha, 1929), as transcribed on Hindi Wikisource by its contributors. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from Wikisource when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Licence: Public domain.
